integrity: The exact finite checker only verifies selected cases; the universal result is established by the written analytic degree-budget and curvature proof.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous independent site retention on finite simple graphs without initially isolated vertices; the all-graph peak theorem requires at most n edges. Comparisons are for expected singleton components, not total fragmentation or bond deletion. Priority not independently audited.
title: A sharp one-third–one-half isolation peak window for sparse habitat networks
